definitions.scope: Recorded formal handoffs and return phases only; not the number of code changes, test retries, development defects, or independently confirmed failures.
definitions.validatedHandoff: Completed review/converge phase with runner-accepted structured response and matching archived SHA-256.
definitions.missing: No validated review means requested changes and findings are unknown, not zero. Procedure A has no separate review/converge handoff; corresponding fields are null.
definitions.comparison: B reviewer requests and C appended tasks have different meanings. No cross-procedure quality score or causal effect is inferred.
definitions.B: A specification correction also routes back through implementation. No second formal review is scheduled after repairs.
definitions.C: Additional implementation means the second implement phase. Convergence outcomes preserve every validated pass, not just the final result.
